verdict.rationale: cubic runs unattended as a GitHub app. It automatically reviews every new PR, can be triggered by PR comments, can auto-approve low-risk PRs and pushes generated fixes, which covers PR-level automation without a human driving it. A CLI exists, but the evidence only describes it reviewing local changes before push, not running non-interactively in a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode, CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or exit codes and gating), API-driven review triggering, independent hands-on corroboration.
